title: Control Axis: 16-Layer ZnSe/ZnS Dual-Band Filter on Ge
scientific_hypothesis: A 16-layer alternating ZnSe/ZnS stack on Ge can simultaneously maximize transmittance in 8000-11000 nm and suppress transmittance in 3000-5000 nm through interference tuning without exceeding manufacturing layer count limits.
design_principle: Recalled knowledge of IR thin-film design suggests ZnSe (higher index) and ZnS (lower index) provide sufficient index contrast for interference effects. Quarter-wave stacking modified for dual-band performance can shape the spectral response. Ge substrate requires matching to air.
proposed_topology: Air | ZnSe (d1) | ZnS (d2) | ZnSe (d3) | ZnS (d4) | ZnSe (d5) | ZnS (d6) | ZnSe (d7) | ZnS (d8) | ZnSe (d9) | ZnS (d10) | ZnSe (d11) | ZnS (d12) | ZnSe (d13) | ZnS (d14) | ZnSe (d15) | ZnS (d16) | Ge
design_variables: Thickness bounds relaxed to [300, 10000] nm per feedback directive
soft_objectives: Maintain physical validity of all candidates
theory_basis: Recalled knowledge: ZnSe and ZnS are standard IR materials with low absorption in LWIR.
Recalled knowledge: Alternating high/low index layers create interference filters.
Recalled knowledge: Ge substrate has high index (~4.0) requiring matching to air (1.0).
Recalled knowledge: 16 layers provide sufficient degrees of freedom for dual-band shaping.
known_risks: Material data coverage for ZnSe and Ge at 11000 nm may require extrapolation (Iteration 12 failed on material_data).
Extinction coefficient (k) might be non-zero causing absorption losses.
Thickness bounds relaxation may allow physically invalid candidates if tolerance is too loose.
I am unsure of exact n/k values at 11000 nm; this would be settled by checking the registry's dataset coverage.
execution_request_english: Optimize a 16-layer planar stack on Ge (Icenogle) substrate with Air incidence. Materials: ZnSe (Querry) and ZnS alternating, starting with ZnSe (Querry) at Air side. Layer sequence: ZnS, ZnSe (Querry), ZnS, ZnSe (Querry), ZnS, ZnSe (Querry), ZnS, ZnSe (Querry), ZnS, ZnSe (Querry), ZnS, ZnSe (Querry), ZnS, ZnSe (Querry), ZnS, ZnSe (Querry) (16 layers total). Optimize individual layer thicknesses d1-d16. Thickness bounds: 300 nm to 10000 nm (relaxed from 400 nm). Constraint validation tolerance reduced by 10%. Wavelength range: 3000-11000 nm. Objectives: Maximize transmittance 8000-11000 nm, minimize transmittance 3000-5000 nm. Use coherent smatrix TMM.
revision_reason: Feedback-directed adjustment of thickness bounds and validation tolerance to recover valid candidates after material_data failure in iteration 12.
